_read: Candidate reference photographs, found and credited on 2026-10-22 to pin the placement of the windows and the architectural members. NONE is calibrated yet, so NONE is listed in the monument's evidence.references: a reference without a fitted viewpoint is worse than none, because compare.mjs would measure against a camera that was never checked. Each needs six points, at least one off the plane of the others, or the fit degenerates into a 110° lens and a camera two metres from the wall.
